Figure 2. The overall framework of AVA-VLA. The architecture operates in three stages: (a) Multimodal Encoding: Visual (vt), linguistic (lt), and historical (ht−1) inputs are encoded into a unified feature vector. (b) Latent Reasoning & RL Denoising Loop: The core reasoning process is modeled as a POMDP. A Reasoning Policy πϕ generates an internal update action ut to evolve the latent state zt. This process is optimized via Reinforcement Learning (RL) with entropy and smoothness regularization to ensure stability. An Exit Gate gω dynamically evaluates state confidence. (c) Action Generation: Once the gate triggers an exit (score > τ ), the finalized latent state is projected by the Action Head πψ to execute the robotic action at.
